preconditions.description: The length of the genome is between 4 and 255.
The length of the string s matches the integer n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ACGT?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: output == '===' or (len(output) == n and all(c in 'ACGT' for c in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either '===' if it's impossible to decode the genome, or a string of length n with characters 'A', 'C', 'G', and 'T' if it's possible.
